The Front Porch.does: The daily morning paper, written fresh at 5:30 AM.
The Front Porch.reads: The day's calendar, weather, flagged email, property numbers (occupancy, late rent, renewals), open tasks, overnight job results, and Carson's replies to yesterday's paper.
The Front Porch.how: A script gathers everything into labeled sections. An AI writer turns it into a short, friendly paper — headlines, a news wire, a sports desk, a mailbag — with at most a couple of web searches.
The Front Porch.result: Posted to its own Telegram topic every morning; a print edition is made too.
The Front Porch.you: Read it. Nothing is sent to tenants or vendors.

Ops - Weekly failure refine.does: Reviews the week's failed runs and turns them into fixes.
Ops - Weekly failure refine.reads: Hermes's own record of every failed or flaky scheduled run across all nine profiles.
Ops - Weekly failure refine.how: If nothing failed, it stops before any AI runs. Otherwise an AI groups the failures, decides whether each was the environment (Mac asleep, network drop, login) or a gap in a procedure, and writes one lasting rule into the responsible skill for each real gap.
Ops - Weekly failure refine.result: A short list in the System Health lane of what it patched and what it left alone — or nothing at all.
Ops - Weekly failure refine.you: Skim the list. It only edits Hermes's own skill notes; nothing outside the Mac.

Property - Ops Daily Digest.does: Morning property dashboard: queues, urgent items, top approvals, overnight health.
Property - Ops Daily Digest.reads: The property-ops inbox and approval queue, today's calendar, scheduled-job health, the latest AppFolio sync, work-order aging, and occupancy.
Property - Ops Daily Digest.how: A script refreshes each source and builds one card: counts, new approvals since yesterday, collections, calendar, and anything broken overnight (plus work-order detail on Mondays). It remembers what it showed last time so only new items are listed. No AI.
Property - Ops Daily Digest.result: One card in the Leasing Back Office lane at 8:30 AM.
Property - Ops Daily Digest.you: Every listed approval still waits for your APPROVE — the digest never approves anything.

Property - Occupancy Report.does: Portfolio occupancy: leased / empty / pending and signed revenue.
Property - Occupancy Report.how: A script totals beds per property, signed monthly rent, and which property has the most empty beds, and warns if the tracker hasn't been edited lately. No AI.
Property - Occupancy Report.result: A Sunday card in the Leasing Back Office lane, plus an archived copy in Notes.
Property - Occupancy Report.you: Nothing to approve. It never edits the tracker.

Property - Tenant Directory Refresh.does: Rebuilds the tenant directory and lease alerts.
Property - Tenant Directory Refresh.reads: A fresh tenant-directory export from AppFolio, pulled by the Mac's browser.
Property - Tenant Directory Refresh.how: A script exports the directory, drops past residents, updates the shared directory sheet and Lyra's local copy (so she recognizes callers), then rebuilds the lease-expiration list. No AI.
Property - Tenant Directory Refresh.result: A lease list in the Leasing Back Office lane only when it changed (always on Mondays).
Property - Tenant Directory Refresh.you: Nothing to approve. It never messages tenants or writes to AppFolio.

Property - Lease Renewal Pipeline.does: Flags leases coming up for renewal in 30 / 60 / 90 days.
Property - Lease Renewal Pipeline.reads: The lease-expiration list built by the morning directory refresh.
Property - Lease Renewal Pipeline.how: A script groups every lease ending in the next 90 days into under-30, 30–60 and 60–90 day tiers, soonest first. No AI.
Property - Lease Renewal Pipeline.result: A Monday list in Lyra's leasing lane (or one line saying nothing is ending).
Property - Lease Renewal Pipeline.you: Decide on renewals. Renewal mailings are a separate step you approve.

Property - Lyra QA Review.does: Scores Lyra's recent calls and texts twice a day.
Property - Lyra QA Review.reads: Lyra's call records and the voice platform's pass/fail checks on each call, plus her leasing-draft queue.
Property - Lyra QA Review.how: A script looks for slips: unlogged calls, failed fair-housing or privacy checks, or a line that's gone quiet. Any check that fails on two or more calls in a week becomes a fix packet for the improvement drafter. No AI.
Property - Lyra QA Review.result: A note in Lyra's lane only when something needs a look; silent when she's healthy.
Property - Lyra QA Review.you: Read the flags. It changes nothing.

Property - Lyra Improvement Drafter.does: Drafts prompt and knowledge fixes from QA findings for Carson's review.
Property - Lyra Improvement Drafter.reads: The QA review's fix packets, the call transcripts behind them, and Lyra's current knowledge and instructions.
Property - Lyra Improvement Drafter.how: If there's no packet, it stops before any AI runs. Otherwise an AI works out why each check failed (missing knowledge, unclear instructions, a tool problem, or a too-strict check) and writes the smallest exact fix, with a fair-housing note when relevant.
Property - Lyra Improvement Drafter.you: Approve or reject. It can't edit anything; approved fixes go live after 5 PM.

Comms - Message Reply Digest.reads: The Mac's Messages app (read-only), filtered to work and resident contacts.
Comms - Message Reply Digest.how: A script finds threads still waiting on a reply, hides door codes and amounts, and flags urgent ones. It stays quiet unless something is new since the last digest. No AI.
Comms - Message Reply Digest.result: A short list in the Leasing Back Office lane.
Comms - Message Reply Digest.you: Ask for a draft if you want one — any reply goes through APPROVE / EDIT / SKIP before it's sent.

Comms - Urgent Message Scan.does: Every 15 minutes in the daytime, flags urgent texts.
Comms - Urgent Message Scan.reads: The Mac's Messages app (read-only), work and resident contacts only.
Comms - Urgent Message Scan.how: A script checks for threads that look urgent and alerts only when the newest message is new since the last alert. No AI.
Comms - Urgent Message Scan.result: An alert in the Leasing Back Office lane, or nothing.
Comms - Urgent Message Scan.you: Respond yourself. It never sends a text.

Comms - Email Pipeline Watchdog.does: Hourly check that the email pipeline is healthy.
Comms - Email Pipeline Watchdog.reads: The email pipeline's heartbeat and whether the Mac is actually awake.
Comms - Email Pipeline Watchdog.how: A script checks that the five-minute email poller is running and fresh. It ignores blips while the Mac is half-asleep, re-alerts at most every six hours, and sends one all-clear when it recovers. No AI.
Comms - Email Pipeline Watchdog.result: An alert in Lyra's lane only when something's wrong.

Property - Daily Rent Roll.reads: AppFolio's late-rent report, pulled by the Mac's browser.
Property - Daily Rent Roll.how: A script refreshes the report and compares it to the last one it posted. It only posts when the total moved meaningfully. No AI, no drafts, no sends.
Property - Daily Rent Roll.result: A card in the Collections & Books lane when numbers move; otherwise silent.

Property - Weekly Delinquency Report.does: Monday past-due report, tiered by severity.
Property - Weekly Delinquency Report.reads: AppFolio's late-rent report and each late account's ledger.
Property - Weekly Delinquency Report.how: A script refreshes the report, compares it with last week, updates the balance sheet Lyra uses for payment questions, and prepares notice emails with the ledger attached — as drafts only. No AI.
Property - Weekly Delinquency Report.result: A summary card in the Collections & Books lane; a monthly copy is archived.
Property - Weekly Delinquency Report.you: Review the drafted notices and send them yourself. Nothing goes to a tenant automatically.

Weekly Collections Snapshot.does: Friday collections snapshot from the latest late-rent and sync data.
Weekly Collections Snapshot.reads: The most recent late-rent report and AppFolio sync, already on the Mac.
Weekly Collections Snapshot.how: A script summarizes late-rent totals and says how old the data is. It doesn't compute profit or loss. No AI.
Weekly Collections Snapshot.result: A Friday card in the Collections & Books lane.

Ops - Cron offline re-fire sweeper.does: Re-runs scheduled jobs missed while the Mac slept.
Ops - Cron offline re-fire sweeper.how: Every 20 minutes a script looks for script jobs that failed with an offline-type error in the last few hours and re-runs them (a few at a time, never twice for the same miss). It also reports any job whose slot was skipped entirely. No AI.
Ops - Cron offline re-fire sweeper.result: One line per re-run in the System Health lane; silent when all is well.

Ops - Playwright Profile Monitor.reads: The Mac's AppFolio browser profile: its size, login cookies, two-factor 'remember me' expiry, and the last sync's result.
Ops - Playwright Profile Monitor.how: A script checks for a damaged profile, stale logins, a two-factor expiry coming up, or a failed sync, and alerts only on new problems. No AI.
Ops - Playwright Profile Monitor.result: An alert in the System Health lane, or nothing.
Ops - Playwright Profile Monitor.you: Log in again when it says so.

Ops - Gog Credential Monitor.how: A script makes a tiny read-only call on each account to prove the login still works, and alerts on new failures with what will stop working. No AI.
Ops - Gog Credential Monitor.result: An alert in the System Health lane, or nothing.

Ops - Lyra Spend Watch.does: Daily voice and AI spend check.
Ops - Lyra Spend Watch.reads: Lyra's voice-platform credits and call volume, the test-spend log, and her worker's health.
Ops - Lyra Spend Watch.how: A script checks credits against a floor, test spending against a monthly cap, and call volume against limits that would catch a spam caller. It posts only when something changed. No AI.
Ops - Lyra Spend Watch.result: A note in the System Health lane when a limit is near.
Ops - Lyra Spend Watch.you: Top up or investigate when warned.

Ops - Approval Re-ping.reads: The approval queue — anything waiting more than two days.
Ops - Approval Re-ping.how: A script groups old approvals by owner and posts one rolled-up reminder per lane, never twice in the same week. No AI.
Ops - Approval Re-ping.result: A reminder in each lane that has stale items.
Ops - Approval Re-ping.you: Approve, decline, or snooze. It never decides for you.

Ops - Hermes Weekly Backup.reads: All of Hermes (profiles, memory, jobs), the workspace, and the planning repos.
Ops - Hermes Weekly Backup.how: A script builds three backups, checks each one, keeps the newest four of each, and trims old logs. No AI.
Ops - Hermes Weekly Backup.result: A success note in the System Health lane — which also proves alerts still work — or a plain-English failure alert.
Ops - Hermes Weekly Backup.you: Nothing. Backups stay on the Mac.

Ops - Plug-in reminder.does: Evening reminder to keep the Mac on power.
Ops - Plug-in reminder.reads: Whether the MacBook is on battery.
Ops - Plug-in reminder.how: At 9:30 PM a script checks the power source. No AI.
Ops - Plug-in reminder.result: A reminder in the general lane only if it's on battery.
Ops - Plug-in reminder.you: Plug it in, so the early-morning jobs run on time.

Memory - Daily Log Writer.reads: Today's log file and the latest AppFolio sync status.
Memory - Daily Log Writer.how: If the day's log is missing or nearly empty at 11 PM, a script writes a basic one so there's never a gap. No AI.
Memory - Daily Log Writer.result: A local log file; nothing posted.

Memory - Weekly Review.does: Updates the long-term memory file with the week's events.
Memory - Weekly Review.reads: This week's approval count, how full each profile's memory is, and each lane's recent activity.
Memory - Weekly Review.how: An AI reports the week's approvals, compacts any profile memory that's nearly full, checks the fact store for contradictions, and flags lanes whose memory hasn't changed in months.
Memory - Weekly Review.result: A Friday report in the Memory & Wiki lane.
Memory - Weekly Review.you: Read it. Everything except memory compaction is report-only.

Lyra - Tenant Wiki Delta Ingest.does: Sunday ingest of new resident Q&A into the knowledge base.
Lyra - Tenant Wiki Delta Ingest.reads: New resident messages and email since last week (read-only).
Lyra - Tenant Wiki Delta Ingest.how: A script adds the new messages to a private, per-resident knowledge base and refreshes its pages and topic links. No AI, nothing sent.

Wiki - Auto synthesize staged memory.does: Turns staged lane notes into wiki updates.
Wiki - Auto synthesize staged memory.reads: Notes the profiles saved during the day, plus the wiki's index.
Wiki - Auto synthesize staged memory.how: If nothing is queued, it stops before any AI runs. Otherwise an AI pulls out lasting decisions and risks, adds them to the right wiki pages with dates and sources, and marks each note done.
Wiki - Auto synthesize staged memory.you: Nothing — the nightly commit keeps a history you can roll back.

Wiki - Curator (chronicle).does: Nightly curation of the planning wiki.
Wiki - Curator (chronicle).reads: Summaries of the day's work sessions on the Mac.
Wiki - Curator (chronicle).how: If nothing is new, it stops before any AI runs. Otherwise an AI keeps only facts that are lasting, non-obvious and costly to forget — dropping anything about people, contact details or secrets — and files them in the wiki or the lessons list. Most nights it keeps nothing.
Wiki - Curator (chronicle).result: Wiki edits only; you see them in Sunday's weekly review.
Wiki - Curator (chronicle).you: Fix any line you disagree with.

Wiki - Curator weekly review.reads: What the nightly curator and Sunday re-read changed this week.
Wiki - Curator weekly review.how: A script summarizes the week's wiki additions and the re-read digest. No AI.
Wiki - Curator weekly review.result: A Sunday summary in the Memory & Wiki lane; silent when nothing changed.

Wiki - Re-read stale pages.does: Re-reads wiki pages that haven't been verified lately.
Wiki - Re-read stale pages.reads: Wiki project pages not checked in 45+ days (up to four a week).
Wiki - Re-read stale pages.how: If none are due, it stops before any AI runs. Otherwise an AI re-checks every claim on each page against the live system, marks anything outdated as superseded (never deleting), and stamps the page as verified.
Wiki - Re-read stale pages.result: Wiki edits; a short digest appears in Sunday's weekly review.

Wiki - Verify Weekly.does: Compares wiki claims to live state and flags drift.
Wiki - Verify Weekly.reads: The whole planning wiki: links, stale pages, open risks, job state, and memory limits.
Wiki - Verify Weekly.how: A script runs the wiki's checks, counts drift, and regenerates the wiki's one-page summary every week. No AI.
Wiki - Verify Weekly.result: A Mac notification when drift is found; snapshots saved locally.

Wiki - Nightly auto-commit.does: Nightly version-control commit of the wiki.
Wiki - Nightly auto-commit.reads: Uncommitted changes in the planning wiki and the tenant knowledge base.
Wiki - Nightly auto-commit.how: At 11:30 PM a script commits any changes so every edit has a history. It never pushes anywhere. No AI.

Unit turn board digest.reads: Upcoming move-outs from the tenant directory, and the turn-board document where checklists get ticked.
Unit turn board digest.how: A script adds a checklist section for each new upcoming turn (codes, filters, paint, clean, keys) without touching anything already there, then counts progress. No AI.
Unit turn board digest.result: A digest in the Maintenance lane when the board changed (always on Mondays).
Unit turn board digest.you: Tick items off on the board. No vendors or tenants are contacted.

Property - WO History Sync.reads: The last 60 days of AppFolio work orders, every status.
Property - WO History Sync.how: A script pulls new and changed work orders into a local history database and counts open versus total per property. No AI.
Property - WO History Sync.result: A Monday digest in the Maintenance lane, archived to Notes.
Property - WO History Sync.you: Nothing. It never contacts vendors or tenants.
